verses.en: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking,
when the earth throws out its burdens,
when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’;
on that Day, it will tell all
because your Lord will inspire it [to do so].
On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:
verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

verses.en: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it,
verses.ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ

verses.en: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that.
verses.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
